description: Trigger evals for dv:cite. Measures whether the skill is selected from the full dv catalog for a given query. Methodology: Anthropic 'Agent Skills' trigger-eval pattern — N runs per query, trigger_rate = selections / N, pass if rate > threshold (should-trigger) or rate < threshold (should-not-trigger). Train failures guide description edits; pick the best iteration by val pass rate. Do not overfit the description to keywords from failed queries.
